function.name: monopoly_odds_calculator
function.description: Calculates the probability of rolling a certain sum with two dice, commonly used in board game like Monopoly.

number.description: The number for which the odds are calculated.

dice_faces.description: The number of faces on a single die. Default is 6 for standard six-faced die.

function.name: calculate_electric_field
function.description: Calculate the electric field produced by a charge at a certain distance.

charge.description: Charge in coulombs producing the electric field. This is a float type value.

distance.description: Distance from the charge in meters where the field is being measured. This is a float type value.

permitivity.description: Permitivity of the space where field is being calculated, default is for vacuum. This is a float type value.

function.name: db_fetch_records
